Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: transparent full-body NPC portrait for an Egyptian underground fantasy RPG. Subject: Kasim, the Return Merchant, a former expedition quartermaster who alone returned from a tomb expedition and now equips travelers to return alive. A sturdy stocky middle-aged man with a weathered kind face, short dark beard streaked with gray, a small healed cheek scar, caring wry smile. Sand-beige wrapped headscarf, rust-red neck scarf, olive brown traveling coat over a worn leather utility vest, modest bronze quartermaster badge, sturdy patched trousers and leather boots. A practical packed leather rucksack with a rolled blanket, a small bronze shield and a sheathed spare sword strapped neatly to its sides, belt pouches and two potion bottles. Relaxed welcoming three-quarter standing pose facing the viewer, one hand presenting a simple bronze short sword safely angled down, the other open in a calm reassuring merchant gesture. Clearly an experienced supply merchant, not a wizard, not a king or an attacking warrior. Premium hand-painted semi-realistic 2D fantasy game character illustration, detailed cloth and aged leather, warm upper-left light, crisp readable silhouette, matching an Egyptian desert shaman NPC with indigo robes and antique bronze accessories in the same game. Entire figure, backpack, sword tip and boots fully visible, centered square composition with 10 percent clear margin around all edges. Transparent alpha background with clean antialiased edges. No scene, floor, cast shadow, pedestal, border, text, labels, user interface, magic, detached particles, cropped gear or cropped limbs. One character only.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: full-body transparent NPC portrait for a hand-painted Egyptian tomb fantasy RPG. Subject: the Nameless Royal Gate Warden, a powerful ancient royal guard with a massive broad-shouldered silhouette, clearly higher rank than an ordinary hooked-sword soldier. Front-facing neutral three-quarter stance, full head-to-boots visible with generous transparent clearance. Closed tall Egyptian bronze helmet with dark faceplate and two narrow subdued gold eye slits, no visible skin or face. Heavy blackened bronze plate armor with restrained aged-gold edges, muted teal linen skirt panels, cracked former royal insignia on shoulder. At the exact CENTER of the upper chest place one large horizontal flat rectangular bronze nameplate visibly scraped blank with deep chisel marks, unobstructed by arms, belt, sword or ornament. No readable lettering or symbols on this nameplate: game will overlay exact hieroglyphs. One immense thick straight TWO-HANDED greatsword with a broad dark steel blade, worn gold crossguard and long wrapped hilt; held in one gauntlet to the figure's LEFT side (viewer left), blade angled down with point just touching beside the left boot, sword must not cross or cover chest. Other gauntlet relaxed near right hip. Very solid planted feet and solemn imposing posture, dignified mysterious guardian, no gore, no skeletal anatomy, no horror. Premium semi-realistic painterly 2D game character art, crisp readable silhouette, subtle weathered metal and leather detail, warm upper-left key light, controlled gold highlights; mostly black bronze and muted teal. Character occupies about 85 percent of canvas height. Genuine transparent alpha background, no environment, floor plane, large shadow, frame, UI, text, particles, smoke, halo or detached pixels. Clean antialiased alpha edges. Entire sword, both hands, helmet and boots inside canvas.
